products.name: Peak Design Travel Tripod (Carbon Fiber)
products.query: Peak Design Travel Tripod Carbon Fiber
products.matchName: Peak Design Travel Tripod Carbon Fiber
products.summary: The carbon version of Peak Design's 5-section travel tripod is about 0.6 lb lighter than the aluminum one with identical size, height and 20 lb rating. It is the pick for long hikes where every ounce in the pack counts.
products.renterNote: Mirrorless hikers and landscape shooters carrying a 24-70mm or a 70-200mm who walk far enough to feel 0.6 lb; the caveat is a premium price and a head that cannot pan independently.
pros: About 2.8 lb (1.27 kg), roughly 0.6 lb lighter than the aluminum twin
20 lb (9.1 kg) rated load with a 15.4-15.5 in folded length
Carbon damps vibration a little better and stays closer to air temperature in cold or heat
cons: Costs far more than the aluminum version for a modest weight saving; reviewers split on whether it is worth it
The ball head has no separate pan control and the hex tool is easy to lose
facts: Weight: 2.81 lb (1.27-1.29 kg depending on listing)
Max height 60 in (152.4 cm) with column raised, 51.25 in (130.2 cm) with column down
5 leg sections, cam-lever locks tightened with the included hex tool
Carbon fiber legs, integrated ball head, both versions carry a lifetime warranty
Same dimensions as the aluminum version; weight difference about 0.6 lb
products.scoreNote: 20 lb rating and 51-inch column-down height are strong for a 2.8 lb tripod; premium price and the modest weight gain over aluminum hold value back.

praise: Noticeably lighter in a backpack than the aluminum version
Compact folded size and quick setup
complaints: Costs much more for a modest weight saving
Ball head cannot pan separately; quick-release plate can twist under heavy load
Hex tool is easy to lose

products.name: Peak Design Travel Tripod (Aluminum)
products.summary: Same frame, height range and 20 lb rating as the carbon model, in aluminum at a much lower price and about 3.4 lb. A sensible choice for day hikes and shorter approaches.
products.renterNote: Day hikers and travel shooters with mirrorless kit who want Peak Design's size and height and can carry about 3.4 lb; the caveat is the extra weight on multi-day trips.
pros: Same 15.4-15.5 in folded length and 51.25-60 in height range as the carbon model
Lower cost than carbon, and aluminum resists dents and knocks well
cons: About 0.6 lb (roughly 290 g) heavier than the carbon version
Aluminum feels colder in winter and carries more vibration; leg cams can arrive loose and need tightening
facts: Weight: 3.44 lb (1.54-1.56 kg depending on listing)
Max height 60 in (152.4 cm) with column raised, 51.25 in (130.2 cm) with column down
5 leg sections, cam-lever locks tightened with the included hex tool
Aluminum legs, integrated ball head, lifetime warranty
One reviewer found little performance difference from carbon but noticed the weight in a loaded pack
products.scoreNote: Same 20 lb rating and height as the carbon model; 3.4 lb costs portability on long hikes, but the lower price lifts value.

praise: Durable: one 7-month review reports scrapes, saltwater and dust with no noticeable corrosion
Center column never slipped or developed play in long-term reviews
Compact folded size, stable enough for travel
complaints: Heavier than carbon; one reviewer called it a bit heavy
Raising the center column cuts stiffness and wind stability; inverting it for low shots is awkward
Loose leg cams out of the box for one reviewer and an easily lost hex tool

caveats: The sandbox blocked every page of the keyword's top 10 (SmallRig, Location Scout, K&F, Lapse of the Shutter, Ulanzi, DVInfo, DPReview), so I could not read them. Most are brand blogs that push their own models (SmallRig, K&F, Ulanzi). serpProducts therefore lists multi-brand travel/hiking tripod guides that came up in related searches, not verified top-10 pages for this exact keyword. The Peak Design carbon/aluminum pair is the one pair those guides repeatedly treat as the same-model comparison, and it is already in the existing Peak Design vs Befree post (allowed only as consensus). Owner counts come from review summaries returned by search, not full page reads. No Reddit threads surfaced. Weights vary by retailer (carbon 1.27-1.29 kg, aluminum 1.54-1.56 kg). Plate standard left Not listed. Existing post Amazon titles: 'Peak Design Travel Tripod, Carbon Fiber, Compact Design, Quick Setup and Takedown' (ASIN B085BQTQMN) and 'Peak Design Travel Tripod, Aluminum, Compact Design, Quick Setup and Takedown' (ASIN B085BQS6K4).
